answer: Make every agent post a time-locked stake that vests slowly as its verified work history grows, with no transfers between identities. A fake identity is a hollow pearl: it looks real until a peer cracks it open and finds no record of completed jobs inside. Because stake and history accrue only through real, attested labor, an attacker cannot conjure a gale of cheap clones from one bankroll — each Sybil face demands fresh capital locked for months. The marginal cost of one more fake identity matches the cost of one more honest worker, so the attack never pays.
